value.rationale: Half graphs are canonical chain graphs with strict neighborhood nesting and are a standard test family for ordered bipartite structure. The result sharpens broad algorithmic tractability to a complete exact theorem: constant optimum four, a unique minimizer for every n at least four, and an explicit n=3 boundary. The rigidity mechanism is structural and not a routine substitution into a known family formula.
